brand.name: Weddings by Kaarya
brand.logo_concept: Gold elephant representing royalty, heritage, prosperity, Indian culture, grandeur.

theme: Dark Maroon Luxury Editorial (Indian Palace Luxury + Modern Minimalism + Editorial Fashion)

rules: MANDATORY: Use ONLY the provided palette.
Use #4E1E27 as the main deep canvas.
Use #5B2230 for subtle section differentiations or card backgrounds.
Use #C9A46B for borders, thin dividers, buttons, and accents.
Use #F8F5EF for main headings and readable body text.
Use #E8DAC8 for metadata, captions, and secondary text.
Headings must use Cormorant Garamond for a regal, magazine-like feel.
Body text must use Inter for pristine readability and high contrast.
Never center-align long paragraphs. Left-align for editorial elegance.

visual_enhancers.borders: Thin gold borders (border-[#C9A46B]/30). Avoid heavy blocks.
visual_enhancers.corners: Minimal rounding (rounded-sm or rounded-none) to maintain an editorial, high-fashion edge.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Premium soft shadows, but mostly rely on stark background contrasts instead of dropshadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise or film grain overlay can be used globally if desired, but keep it extremely faint.
visual_enhancers.motifs: Traditional Indian motifs, lotus patterns, temple-inspired corners can be implemented via thin gold SVG accents.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24, py-32, or py-48 for main sections. Let elements breathe. 2-3x normal spacing.
layouts.grid: Bento grid for services, but spaced widely (gap-8 or gap-12). Masonry for gallery.

sections.Hero: Full-screen cinematic. Dark overlay (bg-[#4E1E27]/40). Logo animation on load. Headline uses masked line-by-line reveal.
sections.About_Kaarya: Numbered manifesto chapters. Left-aligned storytelling. Big drop caps or oversized numbers.
sections.Signature_Services: 9 categories: Venue & Setup, Design & Décor, Planning & Coordination, Transportation & Logistics, Gifting & Guest Care, Entertainment & Performances, Beauty & Styling, Documentation & Media, Culinary. Elegant cards with thin gold borders.
sections.Wedding_Gallery: Editorial masonry. Images default to grayscale, fade to color on hover.
sections.Wedding_Journey: Vertical timeline. Minimalist gold line connecting steps: Dream, Design, Deliver, Forever.
sections.Why_Choose_Kaarya: Luxury icons, plenty of negative space. Symmetrical or carefully staggered grid.
sections.Marquee: Slow editorial marquee separating sections, using serif font, possibly outlined text.
sections.Contact: Luxurious wedding inquiry form. Use customized inputs with gold borders and dark backgrounds.

motion.reveals: Framer-motion scroll reveals. Fade up and slow drift. No bouncy animations.
motion.hero_load: Masked line-by-line reveal. Elephant logo scales down and fades into the header.
motion.hover: Slow, deliberate hovers. Image scale up slightly inside a clipped frame. Grayscale to color for gallery (duration-700).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast. Use dark maroon scrims/overlays where necessary.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, forms) MUST include data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark maroon and gold color palette. DO NOT inject external colors or default tailwind blues/grays.
Write all React code in .js or .jsx files, NOT .tsx.

Header must have a solid or semi-solid background (e.g., bg-[#4E1E27] or bg-[#4E1E27]/95). DO NOT use a completely transparent background in the header, overlays, or any surface with content under it.
Implement Framer Motion for cinematic text reveals (line-by-line) and scroll animations.
Gallery images must be styled with tailwind classes `grayscale transition-all duration-700 hover:grayscale-0`.
Do not use generic Shadcn components out of the box without restyling them to fit the luxury aesthetic (e.g., remove rounding, add gold borders, adjust backgrounds to maroon).
Avoid glassmorphism, bright colors, and neon glows.
Include the tagline 'Dream. Design. Deliver.' in the loading screen, hero, about section, and footer.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and form inputs for testing purposes.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but avoiding glassmorphism per instructions.
Never apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
Never center align the main app container.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Missing categories of images should NOT be replaced by placeholder text. Use provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs.
